conclusions: Step 04 slow samples are isolated per scenario and spread across measured iterations, which argues against one deterministic slow scenario shape.
Step 04 replay timing includes GestureMachine.Input calls, SpinWait watcher synchronization, and the observed-stroke read; validation is outside that stopwatch.
Step 05 attribution shows the largest total outliers are dominated by observation wait time, not raw input time.
Raw input time is normally small, but a few press Input calls exceed 1 ms, likely reflecting state transition and watcher reset/start scheduling rather than motion path cost.
Validation overhead is effectively negligible relative to replay and watcher wait timings.
